name: vscode-api2ai
description: Language support and code generation for the .api2ai DSL (OpenAPI → MCP tools).

scripts.build: npm run build:prepare && tsc -b tsconfig.json && node esbuild.mjs && node embed-cli-bundle.mjs && node verify-demos-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.watch: npm run build:prepare && npm run embed-cli:onetime && concurrently -n tsc,esbuild -c blue,yellow "tsc -b tsconfig.json --watch" "node esbuild.mjs --watch"
scripts.extension:vsix: npm run langium:generate --prefix ../.. && npm run build --prefix ../.. && shx cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links && shx rm -f LICENSE
scripts.release:vsix: sh -c 'tag=$(node -p "require(\"./package.json\").name+\"-\"+require(\"./package.json\").version"); test -f "$tag.vsix" || { echo "[release:vsix] missing $tag.vsix — run npm run extension:vsix first"; exit 1; }; gh release create "$tag" "$tag.vsix" --title "$(node -p "const p=require(\"./package.json\");p.name+\" \"+p.version")" --notes "Internal test build of the Cursor/VS Code extension (prerelease on GitHub)." --prerelease; echo "[release:vsix] done $tag"'
